stories.title: Nvidia's board weighs removing CEO Jensen Huang; no decision yet
stories.summary: Nvidia's board met late on Wednesday to decide whether to remove CEO Jensen Huang, and no decision had been reported, per Al Jazeera and Forbes. Nvidia is the biggest name in the AI trade that has driven tech stocks, so a leadership shock here can weigh on risky assets in general. Nvidia reports results on 17 November.
points: After hours on Wednesday the stock fell 8.61% to $158.78, after closing the regular session 2.92% higher at $173.73, per Forbes.
Before the US open on Thursday, Newsquawk said the shares were down 5.5% in pre-market, and Seeking Alpha said they fell about 6%.
The board met late on Wednesday to decide whether to remove Huang, per Al Jazeera; House committee chairs have asked him to a closed-door briefing on 18 November.
Bloomberg named CFO Kress among the favourites for an interim CEO, per Newsquawk.
Nvidia's Q3 results call is at 5pm ET on 17 November, per Nvidia.

sources.label: Al Jazeera: can Nvidia's board remove its founder?

stories.title: Bitcoin funds lose $1.44B in five days
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds had net outflows for a fifth straight trading day on Wednesday 11 November, about $300M. Steady selling from these funds means less new money coming into bitcoin.
points: Net outflow on 11 Nov was $299.8M per Farside data reported by CoinInsider; Decrypt gives $299.9M.
BlackRock's IBIT lost $269.7M and Grayscale's GBTC $39.1M, while Morgan Stanley's MSBT took in about $9M, per CoinInsider.
The five-day streak totals about $1.44B, and November so far is about -$1.88B, per CoinInsider and Decrypt.
The funds hold $93.7B, down about 45% from a $169.5B peak in October 2025, per Decrypt.
Decrypt quotes HashKey's Tim Sun saying the outflows are 'far from a full-scale retreat', at about 2.6% of the $55.1B that has flowed in since launch.

sources.label: Decrypt: bitcoin ETFs bleed $1.4B in five days

stories.title: Markets price a December Fed rate hike as near-certain
stories.summary: After Fed Governor Waller said he would still support a quarter-point rate increase in December, futures markets moved to price a hike at the 8-9 December meeting as all but certain. Higher rates make savings and bonds pay more, which tends to pull money away from risky assets like crypto. Five Fed officials speak today and producer prices come out on Friday.
points: Waller said he would support raising the policy rate by 25 basis points (a quarter point) at the December meeting, per Digital Today.
CME FedWatch odds of a quarter-point hike rose to 96.3% from 76.3% after his remarks, per Digital Today.
A later reading showed a 90.8% chance of a quarter-point hike and 9.2% of a half-point hike, 100% in total, per ChainCatcher via KuCoin.
The US 10-year Treasury yield was 4.99%, per Newsquawk.

briefs.title: Chainstack discloses breach of customer data
briefs.summary: The blockchain node provider says customer names, emails and password hashes were exposed after attackers got in through a test system left on default admin login; no fund losses were reported, per The Block.

briefs.title: Tron, Tether and Chainalysis form crime task force
briefs.summary: The group aims to freeze stolen or illicit USDT on Tron faster; Tether says it has frozen over $7B linked to illicit activity, per The Block.

briefs.title: Binance hack funds laundered through homemade meme coins
briefs.summary: Elliptic says North Korean hackers are moving funds from the 29 October Binance hack through at least six meme coins they created on NEAR, per Eurasia Review.

briefs.title: OKX and ICE set 23 Nov launch for tokenized stocks
briefs.summary: OKXICE plans to open its US venue for blockchain-based shares and ETFs on 23 November under the SEC's innovation exemption, per The Block.

briefs.title: MSCI to drop Strategy and Metaplanet after 30 Nov
briefs.summary: Both bitcoin-holding companies leave MSCI's indexes after the 30 November close; Strategy estimated up to about $2.8B of index-fund selling, per KuCoin.

briefs.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks fastest since 2022
briefs.summary: Total stablecoin supply fell $14.2B over 30 days, the biggest drop since 2022, per Glassnode data reported by The Block. Fewer stablecoins means less cash parked in crypto ready to buy.

briefs.title: Bitcoin miner reserves lowest since 2009
briefs.summary: Miners hold about 1.19M BTC, the lowest since 2009, while bitcoin flowing into exchanges hit a nine-month high, per crypto.news.
